integrity: The claim was reconstructed from published Stiefel and Gysin inputs plus a natural color-equivariant projection and an explicit orientation-preserving fixed cell. Finite signed Lefschetz tests support but do not replace the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology representations only; no integral quotient torsion, no integral representation lattice, no full dihedral-equivariant Stiefel homeomorphism, no independent validation. The 2005 Stiefel classification and one-reflection action are published inputs; the complete joint character is the asserted refinement.
title: Joint color and pentagon symmetry of graph-coloring manifolds
